scenarios.name: healthy_noise_below_slack
scenarios.description: Flow error swinging to +/-7 L/s on a 200 L/s setpoint — 2.97 sigma, just inside the k = 3 slack. Neither accumulator ever leaves zero, so no amount of elapsed time produces an alarm. This is the whole point of the slack parameter.

scenarios.name: sustained_over_delivery_alarms
scenarios.description: A steady +14.16 L/s (6 sigma) over-delivery on a 200 L/s setpoint — 7% of setpoint, well inside VAV-FC-053's 30% tracking band, so no threshold rule sees it. S climbs 3 per sample from the moment the gate opens and passes h = 20 seven samples later.

scenarios.name: sustained_under_delivery_alarms
scenarios.description: The mirror case: a steady -14.16 L/s under-delivery drives T, not S, so the direction flags separate a box delivering too much air from one starving its zone.

scenarios.name: occupancy_reset_clears_accumulation
scenarios.description: Same 6 sigma bias as sustained_over_delivery_alarms, which alone alarms at 3960 s. Occupancy drops at 3900 s with S at 18, one sample short of h. The accumulator is forced to zero, and when occupancy returns at 4200 s the rule serves the first hour again before restarting from zero — so the alarm arrives at 8160 s instead.

scenarios.name: first_hour_excluded
scenarios.description: A 20 sigma flow error present from load. One sample past the gate would carry S to 34, yet nothing asserts for the whole first hour — the exclusion window is honoured against an error large enough to alarm immediately.

scenarios.name: alarm_limit_bracketed
scenarios.description: A +9.44 L/s (4 sigma) bias adds exactly 1 to S per sample, walking the accumulator across h one unit at a time: silent at S = 19 (4680 s), asserting at S = 21 (4800 s). The S = 20 sample is skipped because a normalized accumulator cannot be parked exactly on the limit.

scenarios.name: alarm_drains_after_error_clears
scenarios.description: The bias is corrected at 5400 s with S at 87. The alarm does not drop with it: S falls by k = 3 per sample and the rule stays asserted for a further 23 minutes. CUSUM has memory, and a host watching the falling edge is watching the accumulator drain, not the box misbehaving.

scenarios.name: unoccupied_stays_silent
scenarios.description: The same 20 sigma error with the box unoccupied all day. Nothing accumulates and nothing asserts — and a false yFault here means NO_EVAL, which yOccupiedOk is what tells the host.
